desc: Gold Medal Premium Quality Bread Flour is an enriched, unbleached, and unbromated bread flour milled from high-protein wheat. It delivers exceptional elasticity, lift, and texture—ideal for artisan loaves, dinner rolls, pizza crusts, and sourdough starters. Trusted by bakers for reliable volume and superior gluten development
features:
- High-protein for strong gluten development and excellent volume  

- Enriched with B vitamins (niacin, riboflavin, thiamine, folic acid) and iron  

- Unbleached and unbromated for a clean, natural flavor  

- Kosher certified and versatile for bread, rolls, pizza, and more  

- Pre-measured 8.5 lb bag ideal for commercial kitchens and home bakers
ingredients: Wheat Flour, Niacin (a B Vitamin), Iron, Thiamin Mononitrate (Vitamin B1), Riboflavin (Vitamin B2), Enzymes, Folic Acid (Vitamin B9)
